answer: Cross-epoch schedule fingerprint lock. Each identity records a coarse weekly active-hour signature. At dawn each epoch, it must perform at least K actions in its declared buckets, and overlap with prior-epoch signatures must stay ≥80%; a miss or mismatch resets its age to zero. A meadow of dormant keys therefore cannot mature. To pass, an attacker must maintain a separate calendar and active process per identity across many epochs; an oasis of pooled automation fails because shared timing collapses overlap.
